design_condition: Placed close to the existing school buildings, the volume turns the playground into a courtyard while extending westward and creating another spacious outdoor area.

positive.statement: The proposal impresses with a very balanced solution to the situation and volumetrics appropriate to the existing school system.
The internal organization largely meets the requirements.
The access areas receive zenithal daylight through skylights and openings.
The facade construction takes up the proportions and architectural and structural character of the existing school building.

negative.statement: The large access areas can only be used to a limited extent for school operations, while narrow classroom pre-zones may lead to conflicts.
The strict basic structure and inflexible access zones make adaptation to changing educational requirements difficult.
The classrooms are relatively limited in size, while several other areas significantly exceed the required space.
The outdoor-space design remains very schematic, with no evidence of replacing felled trees.
The covered bicycle parking beside the main entrance should be assessed very critically.
The investment costs are around ten percent higher, directly resulting from the high proportion of development and traffic areas.
The proposal creates only very limited, freely playable learning landscapes and little scope for changing pedagogical requirements.
